scientific_integrity: Proof-based result with symbolic and finite diagnostics; not independently audited. No computational sampling is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The high-lobe attraction windows are on p=0, |a-g|<1; this is an exact primitive period-two result, not a global attractor or other-period classification. Nonhyperbolic endpoints are not classified nonlinearly. The origin paper and earlier small-gain two-cycle theorem are credited; unindexed equivalents may exist.
title: An infinite staircase of attracting high-amplitude two-cycles in a symmetric sine-delay map
